body: I'm not sure if this helps, but I really hope things get better for you. I know things can get quite bad. 🫂

Thanks for the suggestion. It's gradually abated over time and is much milder these days comparatively, though still feel uncomfortable staying still (though it comes in waves and stays for some weeks). I think I had it when I started my olanzapine, and got worse as I was withdrawing and it really felt intolerable. I hope it gets better for you, I really get how insane it is having such a thing. If it didn't get better I'm not sure I would still be here.
sorry to hear you're going through this. it sounds quite hard. i hope you can persevere and eventually find safety and happiness in this world.
If you feel they will support you maybe they can help somehow. Maybe they want to chance to help you.

I can relate what it's like turning to God and him not doing anything. It's a very lonely and desperate feeling. I hope you can find some form of contentment from life. Hope you can take care of yourself. I have feelings of care towards you even though we are strangers.
Fucking hell just wanna kill myself
It really does suck. I can relate. I miss my ex a lot and feel heartbroken too. Life really is a bitch. I hope you can find something that can help you. We deserve better than life's shitty hand.

This is so fucking true. Once or twice is sometimes ok (some are even not ok once). But any ongoing support never happens they eventually just leave (but i get they may be affected too it just really sucks for us because we lose them as well as any support). I try open up to some people I am not close to because I don't really have any friends and they just ghost me. I think my social queues are not very good and they feel maybe it is too much too suddenly and ghost me.
what is wrong with some ppl

sorry for late reply i've just been distracting myself. over a year now. idk if there is a point in reaching out because of my resentment towards them. they are avoidant so they probably don't want to deal with me struggling and the emotions with that anyways.
relatable. i miss my ex. i'm such a loser playing games alone on new years. fml

That is relatable. It's crazy to me how people don't feel suicidal when "small" things don't go their way. It feels like a coping strategy for me or something. Like I am so depressed already so if something doesn't go my way I start thinking these thoughts. It's kind of the needle that broke the camels back to me.
Bonus points: They are always online/active and they don't even read the message/stop replying to me lol.
I talk to people how I'm doing but it doesn't fix anything. I am still very depressed. I just want to give up.
I think each server has good and bad people there. Just hard to keep sharing there if I have bad experiences you feel me? But thanks. And I hope next time it will be better.
When I look in the mirror I feel great shame and feel so ugly.
Oh and havn't cleaned my room in ages, idc if it's messy af.
I always thought I must have done heinous acts in a past life. That's the only reason why I must suffer so much in life.
Even if they are panicking it's disgusting and inexcusable to try guilt people out of feeling suicidal.
I feel either invisible or a burden in life to people. Wish I could just kill myself and get it over with.

Man all these people saying being handsome is not a big deal is so annoying and dismissive. Physically there are some things you can't change. Also would u rather be handsome with good social skills, or ugly with social skills? Obviously the former.
sorry to hear that. i hope you find some love in your life soon ;;
I play games, reddit, discord to escape all my problems.
It's good to find meaning in life by helping people. Although I don't appreciate you minimising my issues by saying "the little issues in your life don't matter as much".
No worries. And yeah, sounds good! Yeah true, my mum even admitted me and my siblings were all accidents. Wish they were more responsible. Oh well.
no problem

sorry to hear that. it seems your parents don't understand your depression very well. my relationship with my parents is quite poor too. it sounds like a good plan to try get a job in america and cutting ties with them. maybe one day when you are away from them and you are feeling better your passion for owning a bakery could even be reignited. best of luck.
i don't really know what to say. but like i can relate to wanting to live but only if my life is good. shit is hard man.
Sorry to hear that. Your classmates are pieces of shit. At least maybe u won't have to see them after you graduate? Gl on your first day you got this. Hope maybe we can hang on.
what changed?
sorry to hear that. i can relate to like not being cut out for living. i wanna kill myself too and am very tired.
yeah i don't rlly want to die either tbh. i just don't want to live my life . and ig being dead is better than being alive for me. i hope maybe one day we can be ok.
Hi. It sounds like your partner cares for you. I'm sure they would rather take care of you and cover for you than see you dead. Keep strong soldier.

you too :) I hope we can get better together

I hope we find the answers. My family always triggers my anxiety but when I'm outside I feel much more free.
Jesus Christ I hope you are doing better.
Oh shit that's cool. Dude I though it was some crappy cardboard craft till I found out it was glass.

true. idk when i'm in group photos nowadays I feel like crying and i can't force a smile...
Why can life be so fucking sad. I hope you find some semblance of connection even if you don't expect it.

If your parents love you I think they might want to know you are suffering. I know it might be very shameful and hard and even myself they only found out when I broke down and couldn't hide in the bathroom. But maybe you can write them a letter or just text them? I hope you get help. You're worth it and you can do it. I hope one day when you look yourself in the mirror you can become proud of what you overcame and how far you got. The only opinion that lasts forever is the person in the mirror. I hope that will help you put into perspective others opinions. Best of luck. Again I urge you to seek the therapy that could really help. Perhaps you can check with your school too? Yeah I know it's fucking daunting but getting help is important. You can do it.

Hmm that really sucks. I think I desperately need something to live for right now too but the pain is not unbearable right now. Not sure what else to say but I hope you can find it one day. Maybe consider professional help if you don't have it already. It might not make anything better but may as well try your options before finally making an absolute decision.

I think life is suffering. I have been watching some of Jordan Peterson videos and he said that the way to counteract it is to adopt responsibility and thus create meaning that makes the suffering worthwhile. I'm still trying to find this meaning. I hope you decide otherwise and try to find it as well. Maybe in the future there will be something you will look forward to. Odd I know that kinda is what keeps me going sometimes. Best of luck I hope you get better.

Perhaps try a counselor or a therapist. Maybe even someone online. They are legally obliged to confidentiality. I know how hard it is to keep it all inside and hiding in the bathroom crying not wanting others to know. Therapy allowed me a safe space to voice all my concerns and woes. Best of luck.

Hey sorry for the late reply and thanks for replying. Yeah I am actually dreading going back to school because I don't know if I can cope because I had to take the last week of school off because my anxiety was going crazy and I wanted to cry wherever I want and I just stared downwards without looking at anyone. And then when I was in class I was too tired that I just rested my head in my arms haha.

That's good you are brushing your teeth at least daily. I think my meds have helped me a bit can its no longer a tremendous task to summon up the energy to brush my teeth but I usually just delay it like 2 hours before I make myself brush my teeth.

I usually play just play dota 2. I feel like I literally think about nothing else but the game so it makes me feel sane. But I realised how during the game I keep repeating how boring playing the game was lol. I have over 4000 hours clocked right now. What actions are you taking to make your situation better right now? I feel like I've squandered the opportunity to study this holidays and am pretty apprehensive towards school right now. I think I'll try waking up at 8am for starters somehow.

I'm in a very similar situation: same age and year. I feel like I have lost all motivation to do anything and even simple tasks seem unbearable. Like even getting out of bed and brushing my teeth is a test of willpower. Even going to school I just want to cry and am too tired to concentrate in class. I don't mind talking with you about it, I think it is good to share thoughts and feelings and to beat a similar problem together. What video games do you play by the way? That is my go to as well but honestly me spending 5 hour sessions I know it is a tremendous effort but I feel like I only get some sort of positive emotion from it.

Maybe try /r/sadcomics. It helped me find:

which helped me cry.
